source.text: Glypican-3 (GPC3)-positive squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC): Histologically confirmed GPC3-positive squamous NSCLC with prior exposure to a checkpoint inhibitor (CPI).

mappings.appliesTo: Glypican-3 (GPC3)-positive squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)

source.text: Participants must have one of the following unresectable, locally advanced, or metastatic tumor types
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status ≤ 1.
Active leptomeningeal disease or uncontrolled/untreated brain metastases.
Active leptomeningeal disease or uncontrolled/untreated brain metastases.
Active autoimmune disease or a history of autoimmune disease with potential for relapse.

Any malignancy diagnosed ≤ 2 years before the first dose of study drug(s), except: The cancer type under investigation in this study, or Locally recurring malignancies previously treated with curative intent.
Requirement for systemic corticosteroids (\> 10 mg/day prednisone or equivalent) or other immunosuppressive therapy within 14 days prior to the first dose of study drug(s).
At least one evaluable lesion for dose escalation, and at least one measurable lesion for safety expansion, as defined by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) version 1.1.
